usage.source_scope: Mechanism development on the consumed two-frame IFC proxy and six-building v2 cohort, followed by one frozen fresh six-building Commons confirmation cohort with human portal-set regions fixed before execution.
usage.project_application: Replace generic single-box door proposals with a top-three functional entrance set before scale-gated active observation, tracking, and reacquisition. Admit it only after a separate target-entity lock.
usage.modifications: Fuse repeated-post door lattices with paired vertical handle apertures. Adjacent leaves are one functional portal identity, not same-class distractors.
usage.expected_effect: Restore correct entrance proposal availability without OCR and without forcing premature unique-door selection.

evaluation.setup: One-shot unchanged dual-family v3 execution on six frozen, previously unopened named public-building glass entrances. The fresh gate required top-three portal-set retention on at least four of six frames.
evaluation.effect: The fresh cohort achieved top-one truth retention on 5/6 frames and top-three retention on 6/6, passing the 4/6 gate. Among the stored top ten proposals per image, 50/60 belonged to the functional portal region; 14/18 top-three proposals did so. No OCR or learned model inference was used.
evaluation.claim_boundary: This supports current-image functional glass-entrance proposal retention only. It does not establish requested-entity identity, public access, traversability, temporal tracking, active-view causality, guidance, arrival, product benefit, user benefit, or safety.

evidence.summary: Frozen mechanism, fresh metrics, hashes, decision, next step, and claim ceiling.
Human functional portal-set regions frozen before the confirmation run.

history.change: Changed the information representation from generic entrance boxes to functional portal sets. Added a paired-handle family after the consumed lattice-only cohort, then passed the untouched six-building confirmation gate at 6/6 top-three retention.
